ryans.name: Ryan Florence
ryans.title: Web developer; co-founder of Remix and React Training
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Florence** is an American web developer and educator who created the first version of React Router in May 2014 [1]. With Michael Jackson, he co-founded React Training in 2015 [2][3]. He later co-founded Remix Software with Michael Jackson, with Kent C. Dodds also described as a co-founder in interviews [2][9].

ryans.name: Ryan Peterman
ryans.title: Podcaster and writer; builder of the Compose ergonomic keyboard; former Staff software engineer at Instagram
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Peterman** is a software engineer, writer and podcaster. He worked at Instagram, part of Meta, for about seven years and was promoted to Staff software engineer three years out of college [1][2][6]. He writes the newsletter *The Peterman Post*, which his site lists at more than 100,000 subscribers, and hosts *The Peterman Pod*, an interview podcast about the careers of technical people [1][12].
known_for: Reducing Instagram's basic video compute time by 94% (Meta Engineering, 2022)

ryans.name: Ryan Greenblatt
ryans.title: Member of Technical Staff at METR; former Chief Scientist at Redwood Research
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Greenblatt** is an AI safety researcher. He is a Member of Technical Staff at METR, a nonprofit that evaluates AI systems, where he works on investigations and risk assessment [1]. Before joining METR in September 2026, he was Chief Scientist at Redwood Research [1][2]. He is best known as first author of the 2023 paper that introduced "AI control" as a research agenda and of the 2024 paper *Alignment faking in large language models*, written with researchers at Anthropic and Redwood [5][6].
known_for: Alignment faking in large language models (arXiv 2412.14093, 2024)
Transcript analysis for METR's 2026 investigation of the OpenAI / Hugging Face incident

ryans.name: Ryan Perry
ryans.title: Senior Field Engineer at SpaceXAI; co-founder of Pyroscope
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Perry** is a software engineer and founder. He co-founded Pyroscope, an open-source continuous profiling project that Grafana Labs acquired in March 2023 [1][5][7]. He is a Senior Field Engineer at SpaceXAI and has written about running his mobile game Rank'em with a team of Grok Bot agents [1][2][3].
known_for: Co-founding Pyroscope, acquired by Grafana Labs in 2023
Rank'em, a mobile game run by a team of Grok Bot agents
